########################################

# Figure assembly LongAIRR Figure 2
#
########################################


```{r}
library(png)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
```

#read in intermediates
```{r}
#A (tapestation)
tapestation_2a <- png::readPNG("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel2/figures/tapestation_ss3.png")  
p2_a <- ggdraw() + draw_image(tapestation_2a)

#B C D (q vs length)
p2_b <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel2/intermediates/p2b_s1_pb.rds")
p2_c <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel2/intermediates/p2c_s1_ont.rds")
p2_d <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel2/intermediates/p2d_ont_r9.rds")

#E (retention)
p2_e <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel2/intermediates/p2e_retention.rds")
  
#F G (length)
p2_f <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel2/intermediates/p2_f_bcr.rds")
p2_g <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel2/intermediates/p2_g_tcr.rds")
```

a, b, c, d
```{r, fig.width=12}
p2_a_b_aligned <- plot_grid(p2_a + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)), p2_c + theme(plot.margin  = margin(r = 10)), p2_b, p2_d + theme(plot.margin  = margin(r = 10)),
                            labels = c("a", "c", "b", "d"), label_size = 7, ncol = 2, hjust = -0.8, vjust = 1.0)
```

e
```{r, fig.width=12}
p2_e_empty_aligned <- plot_grid(p2_e, labels = c("e"), label_size = 7, hjust=-0.5, vjust=-0.8, rel_heights = c(1,0.3))
p2_e_empty_aligned
```

f, g
```{r}
p2_f_g <- plot_grid(p2_f, p2_g, labels = c("f", "g"), label_size = 7, hjust=-1.5, vjust=1.1, ncol=2)
p2_f_g
```

e, f, g
```{r, fig.width=12}
p2_e_to_g <- plot_grid(p2_e_empty_aligned + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)), p2_f_g, nrow=2, rel_heights = c(1,1.3))
p2_e_to_g <- p2_e_to_g + theme(plot.margin  = margin(r = 10))
```

p2 full
```{r, fig.height=9, fig.width=7}
p2_complete <- plot_grid(p2_a_b_aligned, p2_e_to_g, nrow=2, rel_heights = c(0.65,1))
p2_complete

ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p2.pdf", plot=p2_complete,width = 7, height = 9)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p2.png", plot=p2_complete,width = 7.5, height = 9.5)
#ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/full_pdfs/p2.svg", plot=p2_complete,width = 7, height = 9, dpi=300)
```
